meme-1.concept: A fan waits for GTA VI from high school until their own kid starts school. Same poster, same wait, years later.
meme-1.title: Waiting for GTA VI

meme-2.concept: The game costs $100 and outweighs a whole monthly paycheck on the scale. Saving for it means instant noodles all month.
meme-2.title: GTA VI vs paycheck

meme-3.concept: GTA VI is finally out, but the PS5 is nowhere in stock. Empty shelf, SOLD OUT sign, scalpers asking $1,500.
meme-3.title: Sold out

meme-4.concept: Leonida University confers the degree of Bachelor of Waiting in GTA VI Studies upon the fans: 13 years of waiting, field of study Waiting for GTA VI, thesis My kid starts school first, signed by Rockstar Games (Dean) and G. Host (Registrar), round stamp paid by my AI agent on make.fun.
meme-4.title: Bachelor of Waiting
